hostProbeInvestigation.observation: ~380 plugin boot + host shutdown pairs at the same millisecond; no uncaught exception, unhandled rejection, plugin failed to start or parent-gone line; one active owner PID remained
hostProbeInvestigation.conclusion: Magpie short-lived host/page probes invoke the plugin entry and exit before taking the lock; the active owner stayed and processed the payment. Not a crash and no safety check was disabled.
